1.w: And these [are] the generations of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And were born to them sons after the flood.

2.w: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

3.w: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

4.w: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, the Kittim, and the Rodanim.

5.w: From these were separated the coastlands of the nations, in their lands, each according to his language, according to their clans, in their nations.

6.w: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

7.w: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

8.w: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

9.w: He was a mighty hunter before the face of YHWH; upon thus it is said: “Like Nimrod, [a] mighty hunter before the face of YHWH.”

10.w: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

11.w: From that land he went to Assyria, and built Nineveh and Rehoboth-ir and Calah,

12.w: and Resen between Nineveh and between Calah; it [is] the great city.

13.w: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

14.w: and Pathrusim, and the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorim.

15.w: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

16.w: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

17.w: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

18.w: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. And afterward the clans of the Canaanite were scattered.

19.w: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; [and] as you go toward Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

20.w: These [are] the sons of Ham, according to their clans, according to their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

21.w: And [sons] were also born to Shem—the father of all the sons of Eber—the brother of Japheth the elder.

22.w: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

23.w: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

24.w: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

25.w: And to Eber two sons were born: The name of the one [was] Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother [was] Joktan.

26.w: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

27.w: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

28.w: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

29.w: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab; all these [are] the sons of Joktan.

30.w: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

31.w: These [are] the sons of Shem, according to their clans, according to their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

32.w: These [are] the clans of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations. And from these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.
